action:
After a standard system update you need to restart x11vnc to make all the
necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that x11vnc created shared memory segments with insecure
permissions. A local attacker could possibly use this issue to obtain
sensitive information or modify screen contents.
isummary: x11vnc could be made to expose sensitive information to local users.

x11vnc.description: VNC server to allow remote access to an existing X session

title: x11vnc vulnerability
